title: Standard format
hay: standard rotating 60-card constructed current standard uses wilds of eldraine forward. there is no fall 2026 rotation; the next rotation is with nauctis: the sunken realm in early 2027. store rcqs through november 29 are standard constructed.

title: Modern format
hay: modern non-rotating from eighth edition on modern is the constructed format for the september–october 2026 regional championships that feed the first pro tour of 2027. spotlight: the hobbit in dallas (sept 4–6) was modern.

title: Pioneer format
hay: pioneer return to ravnica forward pioneer sits between standard and modern. after the cori-steel cutter ban, izzet spells shells and green badgermole cub piles split the winner's metagame in august 2026.

title: Commander format
hay: commander 100-card singleton, most-played format commander (edh) is the most popular way to play magic. lists here are recent duel commander league tables from august–september 2026, plus the same 100-card singleton rules used at commander night.

title: Legacy format
meta: Vintage-adjacent, banned list not restricted list
hay: legacy vintage-adjacent, banned list not restricted list legacy is eternal constructed with a banned list. the fantasticar was banned in legacy on august 10, 2026.

title: Vintage format
hay: vintage the original constructed format vintage uses a restricted list instead of a wide ban list. the fantasticar was restricted in vintage on august 10, 2026.

title: Pauper format
hay: pauper commons only pauper is constructed using only cards printed at common. wizards also clarified secret lair zeta commons legality in september 2026.
